name: Machine Crunch
steps: Sit in the crunch machine and settle your feet under the lower pads if fitted.
Grasp the shoulder handles or rest your chest against the pad, depending on the machine.
Exhale and contract your abs to curl your rib cage smoothly down toward your pelvis.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the crunch while squeezing your abdominals firmly.
Control the resistance slowly back to the upright starting position without letting the stack clank.
tips: Focus on flexing your spine rather than pulling down heavily with your arms or leaning from the hips alone.
Move deliberately without jerking the machine forward using body weight.
